🎬 Scream 7 (2026)

Scream 7 brings the terrifying Ghostface killer back for another deadly chapter in the legendary horror franchise, this time targeting someone who has spent years trying to escape the nightmares of her past. Sidney Prescott has finally built a peaceful life with her family, leaving behind the horrifying murders and traumatic experiences that once defined her existence. However, her hard-earned happiness is shattered when a mysterious new Ghostface killer emerges in her quiet town, turning her worst fears into reality. As the masked murderer begins targeting those closest to her, Sidney discovers that her daughter, Tatum, has become the center of a terrifying new killing spree. Determined to protect her family at any cost, Sidney must confront the horrors she thought she had escaped while uncovering the identity and motives of the dangerous person hiding behind the familiar mask. With fear spreading throughout the community, suspicious behavior, unexpected threats, and shocking confrontations make it increasingly difficult to determine whom she can trust. As the danger intensifies, Sidney finds herself fighting not only for her own survival but also for the future of the people she loves most. Combining brutal suspense, mysterious phone calls, terrifying encounters, and unexpected twists, Scream 7 delivers another intense chapter in the iconic slasher series. The film explores survival, trauma, revenge, family, courage, and the terrifying consequences of a past that refuses to stay buried.

🎭 Genre: Horror • Mystery • Thriller

⭐ IMDb: 5.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 54m • R

🎥 Director: Kevin Williamson

✍️ Writers: Kevin Williamson & Guy Busick

📅 Release Date: February 27, 2026

📺 Where to Watch: Paramount+ in the United States. Also available through digital rental or purchase platforms, including Amazon Prime Video and Apple TV. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Scream 7 is a 2026 American slasher film directed by Kevin Williamson and written by Williamson and Guy Busick. It is the sequel to Scream VI (2023) and the seventh installment in the Scream film series. The film stars Neve Campbell, Jasmin Savoy Brown, Mason Gooding, David Arquette, Matthew Lillard, and Courteney Cox reprising their roles from the previous films, with Isabel May, Anna Camp, Michelle Randolph, Jimmy Tatro, Mckenna Grace, Asa Germann, Celeste O'Connor, Sam Rechner, Mark Consuelos, Tim Simons, and Joel McHale also starring.
